SYNOPSIS

chattr [ -RVf ] [ mode ] files...

DESCRIPTION

The format of a symbolic mode is +-=[aAi].

The letters select the attributes: append only (a), no atime updates (A), immutable (i).

The operator '+' causes the selected attributes to be added to the existing attributes of the files; '-' causes them to be removed; and '=' causes them to be the only attributes that the files have.

ATTRIBUTES

i
A file with the 'i' attribute cannot be modified.
I
The 'I' attribute is read-only.
